sentences.text: Michael Schumacher -LRB- -LSB- ˈmɪçaʔɛl ˈʃuːmaxɐ -RSB- ; born 3 January 1969 -RRB- is a German retired racing driver .	racing driver	racing driver

He is a seven-time Formula One World Champion and is widely regarded as one of the greatest Formula One drivers of all time .	Formula One	Formula One	World Champion	List of Formula One World Drivers' Champions
He was named Laureus World Sportsman of the Year twice .	Laureus World Sportsman of the Year	Laureus World Sports Award for Sportsman of the Year
He won two titles with Benetton in and before moving to Ferrari where he drove for eleven years .	Benetton	Benetton Formula	Ferrari	Scuderia Ferrari
His time with Ferrari yielded five consecutive titles between and .	Ferrari	Scuderia Ferrari

Schumacher holds many of Formula One 's driver records , including most championships , race victories , fastest laps , pole positions and races won in a single season -- 13 in 2004 -LRB- the last record was equalled by fellow German Sebastian Vettel nine years later -RRB- .	Formula One	Formula One	driver records	List of Formula One driver records	2004	2004 Formula One season	Sebastian Vettel	Sebastian Vettel

In 2002 , he became the only driver in Formula One history to finish in the top three in every race of a season and then also broke the record for most consecutive podium finishes .	Formula One	Formula One	2002	2002 Formula One season
According to the official Formula One website , he is `` statistically the greatest driver the sport has ever seen '' .	Formula One	Formula One

After beginning in karting , Schumacher won the German drivers ' championships in Formula König and Formula Three before joining Mercedes in the World Sportscar Championship .	Mercedes	Mercedes-Benz in Formula One	karting	Kart racing	Formula König	Formula König	Formula Three	Formula Three	World Sportscar Championship	World Sportscar Championship

In 1991 , his Mercedes-funded race debut for the Jordan Formula One team resulted in Schumacher being signed by Benetton Formula One team as their driver for the rest of that season .	Jordan	Jordan Grand Prix	Benetton	Benetton Formula	Mercedes	Mercedes-Benz in Formula One	Formula One	Formula One

Establishing himself as a top driver , finishing third in 1992 and fourth in 1993 , Schumacher became the first German World Drivers ' Champion in 1994 by one point over Damon Hill .	Damon Hill	Damon Hill	1994	1994 Formula One season
In 1995 he repeated the success , this time with a greater margin .
Schumacher moved to Ferrari in 1996 .	Ferrari	Scuderia Ferrari

Schumacher came close to winning the 1997 and 1998 titles , before breaking his leg at the 1999 British Grand Prix , ending another title run .	1999 British Grand Prix	1999 British Grand Prix	1997	1997 Formula One season
Schumacher won five consecutive drivers ' titles from 2000 to 2004 .	2004	2004 Formula One season
Schumacher retired from Formula One driving in 2006 staying with Ferrari as an advisor .	Ferrari	Scuderia Ferrari	Formula One	Formula One
He came close to an eighth title that year , but due to technical problems in the final two races he fell short to Fernando Alonso .	Fernando Alonso	Fernando Alonso
Schumacher agreed to return for Ferrari part-way through 2009 , as cover for the badly injured Felipe Massa , but was prevented by a neck injury .	Ferrari	Scuderia Ferrari	Felipe Massa	Felipe Massa

Schumacher returned to Formula One on a permanent basis from 2010 with the Mercedes team before retiring for a second time at the conclusion of the 2012 season .	Mercedes	Mercedes-Benz in Formula One	Formula One	Formula One

His career was not without controversy , including being twice involved in collisions in the final race of a season that determined the outcome of the World Championship , with Damon Hill in 1994 in Adelaide , and with Jacques Villeneuve in 1997 in Jerez .	Damon Hill	Damon Hill	1994	1994 Formula One season	Adelaide	1994 Australian Grand Prix	Jacques Villeneuve	Jacques Villeneuve	1997	1997 Formula One season	Jerez	1997 European Grand Prix
Off the track , Schumacher is an ambassador for UNESCO and a spokesman for driver safety .	UNESCO	UNESCO
He has been involved in numerous humanitarian efforts throughout his life and donated tens of millions of dollars to charity .

Schumacher and his younger brother , Ralf , are the only brothers to win races in Formula One , and they were the first brothers to finish 1st and 2nd in the same race , a feat they repeated in four subsequent races .	Formula One	Formula One	Ralf	Ralf Schumacher
In December 2013 , Schumacher suffered a serious head injury in a skiing accident .
He was airlifted to a hospital and placed in a medically induced coma , having suffered a traumatic brain injury .	medically induced coma	Induced coma
He was in the coma for six months from 29 December 2013 until 16 June 2014 .
He left the hospital in Grenoble for further rehabilitation at the University Hospital -LRB- CHUV -RRB- in Lausanne .	Grenoble	Grenoble	Lausanne	Lausanne
On 9 September 2014 , Schumacher was relocated to his home where he continues to receive medical treatment and rehabilitation privately .
